Re: 

Noris Babb v.  Robert Wilkie, No.  18-882 

Dear Ms. McNemey: 

Pursuant  to  Supreme  Court  Rule  30.4,  the  parties  respectfully  request  an  extension  of 

time on the briefing schedule in the above-captioned case. 

The parties'  proposed schedule reflects  our understanding that Ba~b  will  be set for  oral 
argument  in  the  January  sitting.  Under  the  parties'  schedule,  the  due  date  for  petitioner's 
opening brief on the merits and the joint appendix would be extended to  September 17, 2019; the 
due date for respondent's brief on the merits would be extended to November 22, 2019; and the 
due date for the reply brief would be extended to December 22, 2019. 

An extension of time is  requested to  accommodate professional and personal obligations 

during the briefing period.  Counsel for both parties have agreed to this proposed extension. 

If you have any questions  or would  like to  discuss  further,  please  do  not hesitate  to  call 

me at (202) 637-3377.  Thank you for your kind assistance in this matter. 

Respectfully,
